name: Ban Chao in the Western Regions
summary: With a few dozen men and local allies, Ban Chao restores Han control over the oasis kingdoms of the Tarim basin over thirty years. In 97 he sends his officer Gan Ying west to reach Daqin (Rome); Gan Ying gets to the Persian Gulf, where Parthian sailors tell him the sea crossing takes years, and turns back.

stops.note: Ban Chao is sent west with 36 men.
Ban Chao's men kill the Xiongnu envoys, and the king submits.
His base for the next twenty years.
Ban Chao becomes Protector General of the Western Regions.
Gan Ying travels west through Parthia.
Told the sea takes up to three years to cross, he turns back.
Ban Chao returns home at seventy and dies a month later.
